armyRules.name: Lock-Step of the Deathwing
armyRules.flavor: The Deathwing advances as one and falls as one.
benefits: A Unit with this Special Rule cannot gain the Pinned Tactical Status while it is within 6" of another friendly Dark Angels Terminator Unit.
drawbacks: A Unit with this Special Rule cannot Rush in a Player Turn in which it entered play from Reserves by Deep Strike.

armyRules.name: Ravenwing Strike and Fade
benefits: After making a Shooting Attack in a Player Turn in which it did not Rush, a Unit with this Special Rule may make a free Move of up to 3" directly away from the nearest enemy Unit.
drawbacks: A Unit that makes this free Move cannot declare a Charge in the same Player Turn.

armyRules.name: The Guilty Secret
armyRules.flavor: Every Dark Angel carries something he will not confess.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Willpower and Intelligence Characteristics.
drawbacks: A Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule cannot declare Advanced Reactions.

armyRules.name: The Order's Silence
armyRules.flavor: The First Legion does not ask what the Lion intends. It moves where he points, and keeps close.
benefits: While Lion El'Johnson is on the battlefield, friendly Dark Angels Units within 12" of him add 1 to their Cool Checks.
When the Controlling Player makes a Reserve Roll for a friendly Dark Angels Terminator Unit, add 1 to the result.
drawbacks: A friendly Dark Angels Unit that is more than 12" from Lion El'Johnson, or any such Unit once he has been removed as a casualty, cannot Rush.

wargear.name: Deathwing oath-standard
wargear.summary: A tattered banner bearing the names of the sworn, carried by the one brother who will never be asked what it is for.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Deathwing oath-standard, every Model in that Unit adds 1 to its Willpower and Leadership Characteristics.

wargear.name: Ravenwing veil-field
wargear.summary: A dispersal screen that smears the heat-shadow of riders and scouts across the horizon.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Ravenwing veil-field, every Model in that Unit has the Heat Shadow Special Rule.

wargear.name: Penitent's rosarius
wargear.summary: A chained reliquary of the Order, said to turn aside what it cannot explain.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Penitent's rosarius has the Warding Rosarius Special Rule.

wargear.name: Ravenwing locator-beacon
wargear.summary: A strobing transponder that tells the whole wing where the quarry is running.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Ravenwing locator-beacon has the Hunter's Mark Special Rule.

wargear.name: Interrogator's brand
wargear.summary: A branding iron and a very patient voice.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with an Interrogator's brand gives its Unit the Confession Drive Special Rule.

wargear.name: Standard of the Long Watch
wargear.summary: A black banner that has never been furled while its bearer lives.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Standard of the Long Watch gives its Unit the Long Watch Special Rule.

wargear.name: Reliquary plate
wargear.summary: Armour inlaid with the sealed remains of a fallen brother.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Reliquary plate gives its Unit the Reliquary Ward Special Rule.

wargear.name: Ordnance auto-loader
wargear.summary: A rebuilt shell-feed that trades the engine's safety for speed.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with an Ordnance auto-loader has the Overcharged Feed Special Rule.

wargear.name: Mantle of the Watchful Knight
wargear.summary: A grey mantle sewn with the vows of a sleepless sentinel.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Mantle of the Watchful Knight has the Unsleeping Vigil Special Rule.

wargear.name: Circlet of the Silent Council
wargear.summary: A plain iron band worn at the Order's closed councils.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Circlet of the Silent Council has the Fear (1) Special Rule and adds 1 to its Focus Rolls in Challenges.

rules.name: Deathwing Assault
rules.summary: The First Legion's oldest warriors arrive where the fighting is thickest.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has the Deep Strike Special Rule. At least half of the Units in the army that include a Model with this Special Rule (rounding up) must start the battle in Reserves.

rules.name: Wings of Night
rules.summary: The Ravenwing strikes from the flank, in the dark.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule cannot declare a Charge in the first Battle Turn.

rules.name: Silent Hunt
rules.summary: What the hunters find, they never report.
rules.text: When a Unit with this Special Rule is deployed using the Infiltrate (X) Special Rule, it reduces X by 3 for that deployment, to a minimum of 3. A Unit with this Special Rule cannot declare a Charge in the first Battle Turn.

rules.name: Inner Circle Mandate
rules.summary: When the Order takes the field, nobody else is given the honour of holding it.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Focus Rolls. Every other friendly Dark Angels Unit within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule cannot gain the Pinned Tactical Status.

rules.name: Warding Rosarius
rules.summary: A chained reliquary, said to turn aside what it cannot explain.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule adds 2 to the result of any Willpower Check it is required to make because of a Psychic Power used by an enemy Model, and has the Feel No Pain (5+) Special Rule against Wounds caused by Psychic Powers.

rules.name: Hunter's Mark
rules.summary: The quarry is marked, and the whole wing knows where it runs.
rules.text: Once per battle, in the Shooting Phase, the Controlling Player may choose one enemy Unit within 24" of a Model with this Special Rule. Until the end of that Phase, every friendly Dark Angels Model adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill Characteristic when making a Shooting Attack against that Unit.

rules.name: Confession Drive
rules.summary: A branding iron and a very patient voice.
rules.text: Enemy Units that are Locked in Combat with a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule subtract 1 from their Combat Resolution Points.

rules.name: Long Watch
rules.summary: A black banner that has never been furled while its bearer lives.
rules.text: If a Unit with this Special Rule did not move during its previous Move Sub-Phase, it counts as having two additional Models for the purpose of determining which Player Controls an Objective.

rules.name: Reliquary Ward
rules.summary: The sealed dead stand guard over the living.
rules.text: While a Model with this Special Rule is in play, every Model in its Unit has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule. If that Model is removed as a casualty, its Unit gains the Suppressed Tactical Status.

rules.name: Overcharged Feed
rules.summary: A rebuilt shell-feed that trades the engine's safety for speed.
rules.text: Once per battle, when a Model with this Special Rule makes a Shooting Attack, the Controlling Player may choose one of its Ranged Weapons and double that Weapon's Firepower Characteristic for that Shooting Attack. The Model cannot make a Shooting Attack in its next Player Turn.

rules.name: Heat Shadow
rules.summary: The heat-shadow of riders and scouts is smeared across the horizon.
rules.text: Every Hit Test made for a Shooting Attack from more than 18" away that targets a Unit including a Model with this Special Rule is subject to a -1 modifier.

rules.name: Hunter of the Great Forest
rules.summary: He is the boy who tracked monsters through Caliban's dark woods, fast and alone.
rules.text: This Model adds 2 to its Movement Characteristic and 1 to its Initiative Characteristic, and subtracts 1 from its Ballistic Skill Characteristic. A Unit that includes this Model cannot be the target of a Shooting Attack made from more than 24" away.

rules.name: Master of the First Legion
rules.summary: On the war-table he is the Order's Grand Master, and the Legion fights as he does.
rules.text: Friendly Dark Angels Units within 12" of this Model add 1 to their Combat Resolution Points and add 1 to the result of their Charge Rolls. This Model subtracts 1 from its Attacks Characteristic.

rules.name: The Lion Unforgiving
rules.summary: His cold anger comes up like a tide, and it will not be turned back.
rules.text: While this Model has lost one or more Wounds, it adds 1 to its Strength Characteristic and 1 to its Attacks Characteristic. This Model must issue or accept a Challenge whenever it is able to, and subtracts 1 from its Intelligence Characteristic.

rules.name: Unsleeping Vigil
rules.summary: He has stood watch through worse nights than this.
rules.text: A Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule cannot gain the Pinned or Suppressed Tactical Status.

rites.name: Oath of the Deathwing
rites.flavor: The first company keeps its secrets in plate that no blade has yet answered.
benefits: Cataphractii, Tartaros and Saturnine Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1). Cataphractii and Tartaros Terminator Squads lose Vanguard (3).
Every Terminator squad and Deathwing Companion detachment gains +1 Willpower.
Terminator squads gain Deathwing Assault: Deep Strike.
limitations: At least two Terminator squads are required.
No Antigrav or Fast Attack units, and at most one Armour unit.
At least half of the army's Terminator squads (rounded up) must start in Reserve.

require.note: Bring at least two Terminator squads.

modifiers.text: Oath of the Deathwing: Deathwing Assault, Deep Strike, Line (1), no Vanguard (3).
Oath of the Deathwing: Deathwing Assault, Deep Strike, Line (1).

rites.name: The Wings Unbroken
rites.flavor: Black-armoured riders ahead of the Host, and no one asks where they ride to.
benefits: Outrider, Scimitar Jetbike and Land Speeder Squadrons may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1). Outrider Squadrons lose Vanguard (1).
Those squadrons gain Wings of Night: Outflank (Outriders already have it).
limitations: At least two Outrider or Scimitar squadrons are required.
No Heavy Assault, Armour, Heavy Transport or War Engine units.
Squadrons with Wings of Night may not Charge in the first turn.

require.note: Bring at least two Outrider or Scimitar squadrons.

modifiers.text: The Wings Unbroken: Wings of Night, Line (1), no Vanguard (1).
The Wings Unbroken: Wings of Night, Outflank, Line (1).

rites.name: Secrets Kept in Silence
rites.flavor: What the hunters find, they never report. What they were hunting, they never name.
benefits: Seeker Squads, Scout Squads and Firewing Enigmatus Cabals may fill Troops slots and gain Shrouded (6+).
Those units gain Silent Hunt: they deploy using Infiltrate 3" closer to the enemy than normal (Firewing Enigmatus Cabals gain Infiltrate (9) first).
limitations: At least one Seeker Squad is required.
No Lord of War, Armour, Heavy Transport or War Engine units.
Units with Silent Hunt may not make Charges in the first battle turn.

require.note: Bring at least one Seeker Squad.

modifiers.text: Secrets Kept in Silence: Silent Hunt, Shrouded (6+).

rites.name: The Inner Circle Convenes
rites.flavor: When the Order takes the field, nobody else is given the honour of holding it.
benefits: Inner Circle Knights squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Inner Circle Mandate: +1 to Focus Rolls, and friendly Dark Angels units within 6" cannot gain the Pinned Tactical Status.
limitations: At least two Inner Circle Knights squads are required.
No Tactical, Despoiler, Assault, Breacher or Inductii Squads.

require.note: Bring at least two Inner Circle Knights squads.

modifiers.text: The Inner Circle Convenes: Inner Circle Mandate, Line (1).
